findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts below are diagnostic of the coordinate program, not direct affinity measurements.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing (50 nodes), and the curve support is [0.0,0.49]; continuous contrast functions are evaluated only at observed nodes with extrapolation disallowed, so any time-conditioned rule must stay inside this support.

Local landmark coordinate contrasts are non-monotone: landmark_00_local_dy shows a strongly negative first rate (z=-72.4) reversing to a positive last rate (z=5.5) with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts, and landmark_00_local_dx similarly reverses (first z=-17.5, last z=8.1) with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts. A constant-direction rule is not supported by these curves.

Landmark_00_soft_mass has a positive first rate (z=9.3) reversing to a negative last rate (z=-10.0) with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, while its whole-window z is small (0.64); the whole-window mean does not capture the within-window reversal.

Branch-adjusted raw-covariance contrasts for global centroid coordinates are not distinguishable from zero (global_centroid_x p=0.60, y p=0.55, z p=0.95; all q>0.69) with same-sign batch fractions near or below 0.5, so no global-centroid coordinate direction is supported.

Shape contrasts are the only branch-adjusted features with nominally small p-values (shape_yy p=0.048, shape_xx p=0.096) and elevated same-sign batch fractions (0.79), but neither survives multiplicity adjustment (q=0.15 and q=0.23), so shape evidence is suggestive only and not a supported direction.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant-direction contrast matches the observed-node curve as well as the time-conditioned one (no reduction in relative node RMSE), the time-conditioning adds no information.
hypotheses.observable: observed-node contrast of landmark_00_local_dy over the observed score times
hypotheses.scope: within the observed window [0.0,0.5] only; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast on local landmark displacement (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy) may track the observed sign reversal better than a constant-direction rule, because the observed-node linear fits show early negative and late positive rates with multiple sign changes.

hypotheses.falsifier: A reproducible same-sign batch effect with q below the multiplicity threshold would weaken this deprioritization.
hypotheses.statement: Global centroid coordinate contrasts are unlikely to carry a reproducible direction, since branch-adjusted raw-covariance effects are null with mixed batch signs.

limitations: No outcome evaluation data for the current study were supplied; all statements are diagnostic of the coordinate program, not of achieved affinity.
Continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed; no polynomial was accepted, so no smooth time-conditioned functional form is validated.

The supplied evidence does not include a validated absolute geometric target or an affinity-head derivative; coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
Multiplicity-adjusted support was read only for the branch_adjusted table; other tables (regional, survival, turnover, joint) were not exhaustively read, so their hypotheses remain unranked here.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Use these observations to provide your response to the supplied molecular coordinate task.
